data.one_liner: A Flutter package providing easy ways to implement customizable splash screens.
data.what_it_does: It allows developers to create splash screens using custom widgets, GIFs, fade-in animations, scale animations, or Lottie animations. It also supports dynamic routing and immersive mode.
use_when: You want a custom splash screen using GIFs, Lottie, or animations instead of standard native splash screens.
You need to perform async initialization tasks or check authentication before navigating to the next screen.
avoid_when: You only require a simple native static splash screen handled purely by Android/iOS configurations.
strengths: Supports multiple animation styles including GIF, fade-in, scale, and Lottie.
Supports immersive mode to hide the status bar during the splash screen.
Allows dynamic routing and async callbacks before navigating.
weaknesses: Not documented for complex native-level splash screen transitions beyond Flutter-drawn widgets.
data.minimal_example:
FlutterSplashScreen.gif(
  gifPath: 'assets/example.gif',
  gifWidth: 269,
  gifHeight: 474,
  nextScreen: const MyHomePage(),
  duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 3515),
)
